comment: restore.c restore_menu() (1599): picking a saved game runs Strcpy(svp.plname, saved[ch - 1]), and the "name-role-race-gend-algn" text of an 18-character name is 34 characters, which with their NUL need 35 bytes of the 32 (PL_NSIZ) that svp.plname[] has. macOS's checked strcpy() (__strcpy_chk) calls abort() there, so record this recipe on macOS (.github/workflows/macos-recorder.yml), not with a Linux recorder, whose strcpy() overflows into the next field and restores the game. Segment 0: an rc without a name asks "Who are you?"; a dwarvish Valkyrie named Sigrunvaldisdottir steps east and saves. Segment 1: the saved-games menu lists her, and a picks her: the process ends on SIGABRT (terminalSignal) before any further screen. Segment 2: abort() came before the restore and before getlock(), so the save file is still there and the next start shows the same menu; q quits. Seeds, clocks, character, name and keys chosen independently.
